prompts.text: What's the funniest way somebody has ever tried to introduce themselves to you?
A friend who always arrives with snacks or one who always knows a new game?
Tell me about a friendship that started because of a harmless mistake.
You get to rename your group chat for one day. What name would make everyone laugh?
Some people become memorable through one oddly specific habit.
Knowing someone's favourite ridiculous joke is a sign of paying attention.
What's a harmless nickname you'd happily let your closest friends use?
Describe a time a stranger accidentally became part of your group's joke.
Two friends each insist they tell a story better. How would you settle the contest?
A dramatic introduction with theme music or a mysterious one-line introduction?
Which tiny everyday annoyance deserves an award for being unnecessarily dramatic?
Tell me about a household mishap that became funny once everything was sorted.
A fridge that gives motivational speeches or a kettle that announces the weather?
Your furniture starts leaving reviews about how you treat it. Which item complains first?
People reveal a lot about themselves through the objects they refuse to throw away.
Matching socks are overrated when nobody else sees them.
What's the most useful thing you've kept for an absurdly long time?
Recall buying something only to realise you already had three of it.
You're organising a competition for the most ordinary household object. What would win?
An alarm clock that sings your name or a lamp that applauds your achievements?
What's a food combination you defend even when your friends raise an eyebrow?
Try a surprise flavour of ice cream or invent a new sandwich filling?
Tell me about a meal that looked terrible but tasted wonderful.
You're asked to name a restaurant after your personality. What's on its sign?
People sometimes become surprisingly competitive about who makes the best tea.
A meal's most entertaining story often comes from the preparation rather than the recipe.
What snack would you choose as your personal mascot?
Describe the first time you attempted a recipe without reading the instructions.
Your favourite food becomes a television presenter. What kind of show would it host?
Eat breakfast food for dinner or dinner food for breakfast for a week?
If your everyday walk had background music, what genre would suit it?
Tell me about a song that made an otherwise ordinary journey unforgettable.
Dance confidently with two moves or learn a complicated routine and forget the ending?
You're hired to choose entrance music for your friends. Who gets the most dramatic soundtrack?
One person quietly humming a tune often sets off an entire room.
A terrible sing-along sometimes makes a better memory than a flawless performance.
Which song would be funniest to hear played during a serious announcement?
Recall mishearing lyrics for years before somebody explained them.
Your phone plays a random song every time you enter a room. What would you hope it never picks?
A karaoke night with no audience or a silent dance party with friends?
What's the most amusing misunderstanding you've had while travelling?
Follow an unusual street sign or investigate a shop with a mysterious name?
Describe an outing where the wrong turn became the best part.
Your city launches a tourist attraction based on your daily routine. What's its headline feature?
Maps never reveal the strange little details people notice when walking somewhere new.
Getting mildly lost with good company is better than rushing straight to the destination.
What's an unusual landmark you'd use to give directions in your neighbourhood?
Tell me about asking for directions and receiving a completely unexpected answer.
You must design a postcard for the least photographed corner of your town. What would it show?
A ferry ride with a funny tour guide or a bus ride with excellent music?
What's a childhood rule you misunderstood in a hilarious way?
Tell me about a school competition where something completely unexpected happened.
Bring back a playground game or teach today's children a forgotten rhyme?
You become headteacher for an afternoon. Which harmless new school rule would you introduce?
Childhood games often make sense only to the people who invented their rules.
Adults should get occasional recess without having to explain themselves.
Which childhood invention of yours would you like to show a modern engineer?
Describe a moment you tried to act grown-up and completely failed.
Your favourite childhood toy writes a biography. What's the title?
Spend an afternoon building cardboard forts or making up outdoor games?
Which fictional character would make the most entertaining person to share a flat with?
Borrow a detective's observation skills or a cartoon character's energy for one day?
Tell me about a film scene that made your whole row in the cinema react.
You get one scene in a film about your everyday life. What ordinary task becomes dramatic?
Different people notice entirely different jokes when watching the same comedy.
Side characters sometimes have more interesting stories than the main hero.
What's a fictional invention you'd request for the most trivial possible reason?
Recall a character you initially disliked but eventually enjoyed.
Your morning routine becomes a television competition. What's the hardest challenge?
Narrate your chores like a sports commentator or announce them like breaking news?
What's a personal talent that's almost completely useless but still impressive?
Tell me about a contest you entered without expecting to do well.
Recognise birds by their calls or identify cars by the sound of their engines?
You're opening a museum of your strangest achievements. What's in the first display case?
People often get unexpectedly proud of the odd things they've learnt to do.
A useless skill becomes worthwhile the moment it makes someone laugh.
Which tiny victory makes you celebrate as if you've won a trophy?
Describe impressing someone with a skill you assumed everybody knew.
A neighbourhood talent show insists that nobody perform a normal talent. What would you demonstrate?
Be an expert at folding fitted sheets or at untangling earphones instantly?
What's the most unusual excuse you've heard for arriving late?
Get one extra hour every Monday or skip one boring errand each Friday?
Tell me about an attempt to save time that took much longer instead.
Your calendar starts giving sarcastic feedback about your plans. Which appointment gets the first comment?
People organise their days in ways that sound baffling to someone with a different routine.
The best productivity hack is finding a reason to enjoy the task.
Which part of your routine would sound absurd if a documentary narrator described it?
Recall a day when everything ran late but somehow worked out well.
You must give your busiest weekday a movie title. What would you call it?
A talking to-do list or a clock that negotiates deadlines?
Which small kindness from a stranger made you grin long afterwards?
Tell me about accidentally making somebody's day better.
Receive a funny handwritten note or a thoughtful doodle from a friend?
You're appointed ambassador for making ordinary queues friendlier. What's your first rule?
Small acts of humour often turn awkward social moments into easier conversations.
Being able to laugh kindly at yourself makes meeting new people less stressful.
What's one silly question you'd ask everybody if you knew they'd answer?
Describe the moment an awkward introduction turned into a good story.
A time capsule needs one ordinary object that represents your sense of humour. What would you contribute?
End a gathering with a group joke or start it with a ridiculous icebreaker?
